page.overview:
Who is Vidala Swoon?

Vidala Swoon is a female Earth pony hairstylist who first appears in Green Isn't Your Color. She has a pink coat, two-tone hot pink mane, greenish-blue eyes, and a varying cutie mark of at least a comb. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.

Vidala Swoon shares her tail design with Sweetie Drops, Shoeshine, "Blue Bows", Lilac Links, "Vanilla Sweets", "Spring Water", "Tree Sap", Grape Delight, "Linked Hearts", "Winter Withers", "Peachy Cream", "Wildwood Flower", "Apricot Bow", "Belle Star", Luckette, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Mare #3, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Mare #8, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #3, S04E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #4, S04E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #5, S04E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #6, S04E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #7, S05E12 Unnamed Earth Mare #4, S05E13 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, and S05E21 Unnamed Earth Mare #1. Her color scheme is similar to that of Pinkie Pie.

Vidala Swoon first appears in the season one episode Green Isn't Your Color as one of the hairdressers associated with Photo Finish. She helps prepare Fluttershy for her first photoshoot, and she also appears in a photo with her and Photo Finish.

Vidala Swoon later appears at Silver Frames' art gallery opening in Sweet and Elite and as a Games spectator in Equestria Games.
